newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt shares drop in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Egypt shares drop in slow trade.

text.p: Egyptian share prices dropped on Tuesday in a sluggish market that saw many strong stocks fall.
The Capital Market Authority (CMA) overall index fell 0.90 points to close at 233.93 while volume was a below-average 14.89 million pounds ($4.38 million).
Central and West Delta Flour Mills led the day's trading with shares worth more than three million pounds changing hands. The stock fell 1.25 pounds to close at 47.25.

The share was registerd earlier this month at a flotation price of 40.00 pounds. The state has privatised 55 percent of the milling company, despite previous official statements that the government would retain a controlling interest in the strategic milling sector.
Helwan Portland Cement was also relatively active, with trade in more than 12,000 shares but it lost value too, falling 0.50 pounds to close at 48.50.
Tobacco monopoly Eastern Company also traded just above 12,000 shares but ended 0.40 pounds less at 47.00.
The CMA index for openly traded firms continued to rise, closing at 368.87 from Monday's 366.58 and the index for rarely traded "closed" firms was steady at 159.94
